title: Private Unit w/ Queen Bed, 20 mins to DT Nash
description:
Rustic, cozy cabin-like unit completely separate from the main house with a private entrance. Located on the outskirts of Nashville in a tucked-away neighborhood of Madison. 20 mins from Downtown Nashville, 20 mins from BNA, and 15 mins from the Grand Ole Opry. Parking space for 2 cars. Firepit and backyard area open for guest use.

The space
This studio apartment was built in the 1970s and is attached to the main house with completely separate entrances. This rustic unit is charming with brick flooring and cabin-like aesthetics. It includes a 55" Smart TV, board games, a stocked Keurig, and a cozy and comfortable dining/sleeping area. There is no full kitchen, but there is a sink, microwave, and refrigerator.

Guest access
Neely's Bend is a commuter road, so no street parking is available, but we do have two open parking spots. Be sure to add in extra time if traveling during rush hour. Peeler Park is just 5 mins down the road and has well-maintained trails to explore.

Other things to note
Airbnb is stocked with k-pods for Keurig use, extra towels, Smart TV (make sure to log out of any accounts signed into when stay is over).
